WITH autos AS (
  SELECT id_auto
  FROM `basedosdados.br_ibama_fiscalizacao.auto_infracao`
  WHERE ano >= 1977
    AND id_auto IS NOT NULL
), embargos AS (
  SELECT id_auto
  FROM `basedosdados.br_ibama_fiscalizacao.area_embargada`
  WHERE ano >= 1987
    AND id_auto IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_embargos,
  COUNTIF(a.id_auto IS NOT NULL) AS embargos_com_auto,
  COUNTIF(a.id_auto IS NULL) AS embargos_sem_auto,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.id_auto) AS autos_com_embargo
FROM embargos e
LEFT JOIN autos a USING (id_auto)

WITH mapbiomas AS (
  SELECT id_municipio, sigla_uf, bioma, ano
  FROM `basedosdados.br_mapbiomas_estatisticas.cobertura_municipio_classe`
  WHERE ano = 2023
  GROUP BY id_municipio, sigla_uf, bioma, ano
), prodes AS (
  SELECT id_municipio, bioma, ano
  FROM `basedosdados.br_inpe_prodes.municipio_bioma`
  WHERE ano = 2023
  GROUP BY id_municipio, bioma, ano
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS chaves_prodes,
  COUNTIF(m.id_municipio IS NOT NULL) AS chaves_com_mapbiomas,
  COUNTIF(m.id_municipio IS NULL) AS chaves_sem_mapbiomas
FROM prodes p
LEFT JOIN mapbiomas m
  ON p.id_municipio = m.id_municipio
 AND p.bioma = m.bioma
 AND p.ano = m.ano

WITH rais AS (
  SELECT id_municipio, sigla_uf, cnae_2_subclasse
  FROM `basedosdados.br_me_rais.microdados_estabelecimentos`
  WHERE ano = 2023
    AND sigla_uf IS NOT NULL
    AND cnae_2_subclasse IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY id_municipio, sigla_uf, cnae_2_subclasse
), cnae AS (
  SELECT subclasse
  FROM `basedosdados.br_bd_diretorios_brasil.cnae_2`
  GROUP BY subclasse
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS chaves_rais,
  COUNTIF(c.subclasse IS NOT NULL) AS chaves_com_cnae,
  COUNTIF(c.subclasse IS NULL) AS chaves_sem_cnae
FROM rais r
LEFT JOIN cnae c
  ON r.cnae_2_subclasse = c.subclasse

WITH autos AS (
  SELECT id_auto
  FROM `basedosdados.br_ibama_fiscalizacao.auto_infracao`
  WHERE ano >= 1977
), embargos AS (
  SELECT id_embargo, id_auto, id_municipio, ano
  FROM `basedosdados.br_ibama_fiscalizacao.area_embargada`
  WHERE ano >= 1987
), auto_keys AS (
  SELECT id_auto, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM autos
  WHERE id_auto IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY id_auto
), embargo_keys AS (
  SELECT id_auto, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM embargos
  WHERE id_auto IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY id_auto
), matched AS (
  SELECT e.id_embargo, e.id_auto, e.id_municipio, e.ano
  FROM embargos e
  INNER JOIN auto_keys a USING (id_auto)
), unmatched AS (
  SELECT e.id_embargo, e.id_auto, e.id_municipio, e.ano
  FROM embargos e
  LEFT JOIN auto_keys a USING (id_auto)
  WHERE a.id_auto IS NULL
), metrics AS (
  SELECT 'origem_auto_infracao_registros' AS metrica, CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) AS valor FROM autos
  UNION ALL SELECT 'destino_area_embargada_registros', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM embargos
  UNION ALL SELECT 'autos_id_auto_nulo', CAST(COUNTIF(id_auto IS NULL) AS STRING) FROM autos
  UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_id_auto_nulo', CAST(COUNTIF(id_auto IS NULL) AS STRING) FROM embargos
  UNION ALL SELECT 'autos_id_auto_distintos', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT id_auto) AS STRING) FROM autos WHERE id_auto IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_id_auto_distintos', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT id_auto) AS STRING) FROM embargos WHERE id_auto IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'autos_chaves_duplicadas', CAST(COUNTIF(n > 1) AS STRING) FROM auto_keys
  UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_chaves_duplicadas', CAST(COUNTIF(n > 1) AS STRING) FROM embargo_keys
  UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_com_auto', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM matched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_sem_auto', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM unmatched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_com_auto_proporcao', CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM embargos)) AS STRING) FROM matched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_sem_auto_proporcao', CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM embargos)) AS STRING) FROM unmatched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'autos_com_pelo_menos_um_embargo', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT id_auto) AS STRING) FROM matched
)
SELECT 'metrica' AS tipo, metrica AS item, valor, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS id_exemplo, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS detalhe
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 'exemplo_correspondente', 'embargo', CAST(ano AS STRING), id_embargo, id_auto
FROM matched
ORDER BY tipo, item, id_exemplo
LIMIT 40

WITH p AS (
  SELECT id_municipio, bioma, ano
  FROM `basedosdados.br_inpe_prodes.municipio_bioma`
  WHERE ano = 2023
), m AS (
  SELECT id_municipio, sigla_uf, bioma, ano, id_classe, area
  FROM `basedosdados.br_mapbiomas_estatisticas.cobertura_municipio_classe`
  WHERE ano = 2023
), pk AS (
  SELECT id_municipio, bioma, ano, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM p GROUP BY id_municipio, bioma, ano
), mk AS (
  SELECT id_municipio, bioma, ano, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM m GROUP BY id_municipio, bioma, ano
), matched AS (
  SELECT p.id_municipio, p.bioma, p.ano
  FROM pk p INNER JOIN mk m USING (id_municipio, bioma, ano)
), unmatched AS (
  SELECT p.id_municipio, p.bioma, p.ano
  FROM pk p LEFT JOIN mk m USING (id_municipio, bioma, ano)
  WHERE m.id_municipio IS NULL
), metrics AS (
  SELECT 'prodes_registros' AS metrica, CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) AS valor FROM p
  UNION ALL SELECT 'prodes_chaves_distintas', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM pk
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mapbiomas_registros', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mapbiomas_chaves_distintas', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM mk
  UNION ALL SELECT 'prodes_chaves_nulas', CAST(COUNTIF(id_municipio IS NULL OR bioma IS NULL OR ano IS NULL) AS STRING) FROM pk
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mapbiomas_chaves_nulas', CAST(COUNTIF(id_municipio IS NULL OR bioma IS NULL OR ano IS NULL) AS STRING) FROM mk
  UNION ALL SELECT 'prodes_chaves_duplicadas', CAST(COUNTIF(n > 1) AS STRING) FROM pk
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mapbiomas_chaves_duplicadas', CAST(COUNTIF(n > 1) AS STRING) FROM mk
  UNION ALL SELECT 'prodes_chaves_com_mapbiomas', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM matched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'prodes_chaves_sem_mapbiomas', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM unmatched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'prodes_cobertura_com_mapbiomas', CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pk)) AS STRING) FROM matched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'prodes_cobertura_sem_mapbiomas', CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pk)) AS STRING) FROM unmatched
)
SELECT 'metrica' AS tipo, metrica AS item, valor, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS id_municipio, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS bioma
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 'exemplo_correspondente', 'chave', CAST(ano AS STRING), id_municipio, bioma
FROM matched
UNION ALL
SELECT 'exemplo_sem_correspondencia', 'chave', CAST(ano AS STRING), id_municipio, bioma
FROM unmatched
ORDER BY tipo, item, id_municipio
LIMIT 60

WITH r AS (
  SELECT id_municipio, sigla_uf, cnae_2_subclasse, ano
  FROM `basedosdados.br_me_rais.microdados_estabelecimentos`
  WHERE ano = 2023
), c AS (
  SELECT subclasse
  FROM `basedosdados.br_bd_diretorios_brasil.cnae_2`
), rk AS (
  SELECT cnae_2_subclasse, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM r WHERE cnae_2_subclasse IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cnae_2_subclasse
), ck AS (
  SELECT subclasse, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM c WHERE subclasse IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY subclasse
), matched AS (
  SELECT rk.cnae_2_subclasse, rk.n
  FROM rk INNER JOIN ck ON rk.cnae_2_subclasse = ck.subclasse
), unmatched AS (
  SELECT rk.cnae_2_subclasse, rk.n
  FROM rk LEFT JOIN ck ON rk.cnae_2_subclasse = ck.subclasse
  WHERE ck.subclasse IS NULL
), metrics AS (
  SELECT 'rais_registros' AS metrica, CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) AS valor FROM r
  UNION ALL SELECT 'rais_cnae_nulo', CAST(COUNTIF(cnae_2_subclasse IS NULL) AS STRING) FROM r
  UNION ALL SELECT 'rais_cnae_distintos_nao_nulos', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM rk
  UNION ALL SELECT 'diretorio_cnae_registros', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM c
  UNION ALL SELECT 'diretorio_subclasses_distintas', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM ck
  UNION ALL SELECT 'diretorio_subclasses_nulas', CAST(COUNTIF(subclasse IS NULL) AS STRING) FROM c
  UNION ALL SELECT 'rais_subclasses_duplicadas', CAST(COUNTIF(n > 1) AS STRING) FROM rk
  UNION ALL SELECT 'diretorio_subclasses_duplicadas', CAST(COUNTIF(n > 1) AS STRING) FROM ck
  UNION ALL SELECT 'subclasses_rais_com_correspondencia', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM matched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'subclasses_rais_sem_correspondencia', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM unmatched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'proporcao_subclasses_rais_com_correspondencia', CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rk)) AS STRING) FROM matched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'registros_rais_com_cnae_correspondente', CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r INNER JOIN ck ON r.cnae_2_subclasse = ck.subclasse) AS STRING)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'registros_rais_sem_cnae_correspondente', CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r LEFT JOIN ck ON r.cnae_2_subclasse = ck.subclasse WHERE ck.subclasse IS NULL) AS STRING)
)
SELECT 'metrica' AS tipo, metrica AS item, valor, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS chave, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS detalhe
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 'exemplo_correspondente', 'subclasse', CAST(n AS STRING), cnae_2_subclasse, 'presente_no_diretorio'
FROM matched
UNION ALL
SELECT 'exemplo_sem_correspondencia', 'subclasse', CAST(n AS STRING), cnae_2_subclasse, 'ausente_no_diretorio'
FROM unmatched
ORDER BY tipo, item, chave
LIMIT 60

WITH car AS (
  SELECT id_imovel, id_municipio, sigla_uf, data_extracao
  FROM `basedosdados.br_sfb_sicar.area_imovel`
  WHERE data_extracao = '2026-08-04'
), s AS (
  SELECT id_car, id_referencia_bacen, numero_ordem, ano_emissao
  FROM `basedosdados.br_bcb_sicor.recurso_publico_propriedade`
  WHERE ano_emissao = 2026
), car_keys AS (
  SELECT id_imovel, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM car WHERE id_imovel IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id_imovel
), sicor_keys AS (
  SELECT id_car, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM s WHERE id_car IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id_car
), matched AS (
  SELECT s.id_car, s.id_referencia_bacen, s.numero_ordem, c.id_municipio, c.sigla_uf
  FROM s INNER JOIN car c ON s.id_car = c.id_imovel
), unmatched AS (
  SELECT s.id_car, s.id_referencia_bacen, s.numero_ordem
  FROM s LEFT JOIN car c ON s.id_car = c.id_imovel
  WHERE c.id_imovel IS NULL
), metrics AS (
  SELECT 'car_registros_snapshot' AS metrica, CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) AS valor FROM car
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sicor_registros_2026', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM s
  UNION ALL SELECT 'car_id_imovel_nulo', CAST(COUNTIF(id_imovel IS NULL) AS STRING) FROM car
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sicor_id_car_nulo', CAST(COUNTIF(id_car IS NULL) AS STRING) FROM s
  UNION ALL SELECT 'car_id_imovel_distintos', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM car_keys
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sicor_id_car_distintos', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM sicor_keys
  UNION ALL SELECT 'car_ids_duplicados', CAST(COUNTIF(n > 1) AS STRING) FROM car_keys
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sicor_ids_duplicados', CAST(COUNTIF(n > 1) AS STRING) FROM sicor_keys
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sicor_registros_com_car', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM matched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sicor_registros_sem_car', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM unmatched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'proporcao_sicor_com_car', CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s)) AS STRING) FROM matched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'proporcao_sicor_sem_car', CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s)) AS STRING) FROM unmatched
  UNION ALL SELECT 'imoveis_car_com_sicor', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT id_municipio || '|' || sigla_uf) AS STRING) FROM matched
)
SELECT 'metrica' AS tipo, metrica AS item, valor, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS id_1, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS id_2
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 'exemplo_correspondente', 'id_car_id_imovel', id_car, id_referencia_bacen
FROM matched
UNION ALL
SELECT 'exemplo_sem_correspondencia', 'id_car_sem_imovel', id_car, id_referencia_bacen
FROM unmatched
ORDER BY tipo, item, id_1
LIMIT 60

WITH autos AS (
  SELECT id_auto FROM `basedosdados.br_ibama_fiscalizacao.auto_infracao` WHERE ano >= 1977
), embargos AS (
  SELECT id_embargo, id_auto, id_municipio, ano FROM `basedosdados.br_ibama_fiscalizacao.area_embargada` WHERE ano >= 1987
), auto_keys AS (SELECT id_auto, COUNT(*) n FROM autos WHERE id_auto IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id_auto), embargo_keys AS (SELECT id_auto, COUNT(*) n FROM embargos WHERE id_auto IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id_auto),
matched AS (SELECT e.* FROM embargos e JOIN auto_keys a USING(id_auto)), unmatched AS (SELECT e.* FROM embargos e LEFT JOIN auto_keys a USING(id_auto) WHERE a.id_auto IS NULL),
metrics AS (
SELECT 'autos_registros' item, CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) valor FROM autos
UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_registros', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM embargos
UNION ALL SELECT 'autos_id_nulo', CAST(COUNTIF(id_auto IS NULL) AS STRING) FROM autos
UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_id_nulo', CAST(COUNTIF(id_auto IS NULL) AS STRING) FROM embargos
UNION ALL SELECT 'autos_ids_distintos', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM auto_keys
UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_ids_distintos', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM embargo_keys
UNION ALL SELECT 'autos_ids_duplicados', CAST(COUNTIF(n > 1) AS STRING) FROM auto_keys
UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_ids_duplicados', CAST(COUNTIF(n > 1) AS STRING) FROM embargo_keys
UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_com_auto', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM matched
UNION ALL SELECT 'embargos_sem_auto', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM unmatched
UNION ALL SELECT 'proporcao_embargos_com_auto', CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM embargos)) AS STRING)
UNION ALL SELECT 'proporcao_embargos_sem_auto', CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unmatched),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM embargos)) AS STRING)
UNION ALL SELECT 'autos_com_embargo', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT id_auto) AS STRING) FROM matched)
SELECT 1 ordem, 'metrica' tipo, item, valor, CAST(NULL AS STRING) id_1, CAST(NULL AS STRING) id_2 FROM metrics
UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'exemplo_correspondente', 'embargo', CAST(ano AS STRING), CAST(id_embargo AS STRING), CAST(id_auto AS STRING) FROM matched QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id_embargo) <= 5
UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'exemplo_sem_correspondencia', 'embargo', CAST(ano AS STRING), CAST(id_embargo AS STRING), CAST(id_auto AS STRING) FROM unmatched QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id_embargo) <= 5
ORDER BY ordem, item, id_1

WITH p AS (SELECT id_municipio, bioma, ano FROM `basedosdados.br_inpe_prodes.municipio_bioma` WHERE ano=2023), m AS (SELECT id_municipio, bioma, ano FROM `basedosdados.br_mapbiomas_estatisticas.cobertura_municipio_classe` WHERE ano=2023), pk AS (SELECT id_municipio,bioma,ano,COUNT(*) n FROM p GROUP BY 1,2,3), mk AS (SELECT id_municipio,bioma,ano,COUNT(*) n FROM m GROUP BY 1,2,3), matched AS (SELECT p.* FROM pk p JOIN mk m USING(id_municipio,bioma,ano)), unmatched AS (SELECT p.* FROM pk p LEFT JOIN mk m USING(id_municipio,bioma,ano) WHERE m.id_municipio IS NULL), metrics AS (

UNION ALL SELECT 'mapbiomas_registros', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM m
UNION ALL SELECT 'mapbiomas_chaves_distintas', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM mk
UNION ALL SELECT 'prodes_chaves_duplicadas', CAST(COUNTIF(n>1) AS STRING) FROM pk
UNION ALL SELECT 'mapbiomas_chaves_duplicadas', CAST(COUNTIF(n>1) AS STRING) FROM mk
UNION ALL SELECT 'prodes_chaves_com_mapbiomas', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM matched
UNION ALL SELECT 'prodes_chaves_sem_mapbiomas', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM unmatched
UNION ALL SELECT 'proporcao_prodes_com_mapbiomas', CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pk)) AS STRING)
UNION ALL SELECT 'proporcao_prodes_sem_mapbiomas', CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unmatched),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pk)) AS STRING))
SELECT 1 ordem,'metrica' tipo,item,valor,CAST(NULL AS STRING) id_1,CAST(NULL AS STRING) id_2 FROM metrics
UNION ALL SELECT 2,'exemplo_correspondente','chave',CAST(ano AS STRING),id_municipio,bioma FROM matched QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY id_municipio,bioma)<=5
UNION ALL SELECT 3,'exemplo_sem_correspondencia','chave',CAST(ano AS STRING),id_municipio,bioma FROM unmatched QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY id_municipio,bioma)<=5
ORDER BY ordem,item,id_1

UNION ALL SELECT 'rais_subclasses_duplicadas',CAST(COUNTIF(n>1) AS STRING) FROM rk
UNION ALL SELECT 'diretorio_subclasses_duplicadas',CAST(COUNTIF(n>1) AS STRING) FROM ck
UNION ALL SELECT 'rais_subclasses_com_diretorio',CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM matched
UNION ALL SELECT 'rais_subclasses_sem_diretorio',CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM unmatched

UNION ALL SELECT 'rais_registros_com_cnae',CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN ck ON r.cnae_2_subclasse=ck.subclasse) AS STRING)
UNION ALL SELECT 'rais_registros_sem_cnae',CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r LEFT JOIN ck ON r.cnae_2_subclasse=ck.subclasse WHERE ck.subclasse IS NULL) AS STRING))
SELECT 1 ordem,'metrica' tipo,item,valor,CAST(NULL AS STRING) id_1,CAST(NULL AS STRING) id_2 FROM metrics

ORDER BY ordem,item,id_1

SELECT 'car_registros_snapshot' item,CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) valor FROM car
UNION ALL SELECT 'sicor_registros_2026',CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'car_id_nulo',CAST(COUNTIF(id_imovel IS NULL) AS STRING) FROM car
UNION ALL SELECT 'sicor_id_car_nulo',CAST(COUNTIF(id_car IS NULL) AS STRING) FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'car_ids_distintos',CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM ck
UNION ALL SELECT 'sicor_ids_distintos',CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM sk
UNION ALL SELECT 'car_ids_duplicados',CAST(COUNTIF(n>1) AS STRING) FROM ck
UNION ALL SELECT 'sicor_ids_duplicados',CAST(COUNTIF(n>1) AS STRING) FROM sk
UNION ALL SELECT 'sicor_registros_com_car',CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM matched
UNION ALL SELECT 'sicor_registros_sem_car',CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING) FROM unmatched
UNION ALL SELECT 'proporcao_sicor_com_car',CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s)) AS STRING)
UNION ALL SELECT 'proporcao_sicor_sem_car',CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unmatched),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s)) AS STRING))
SELECT 1 ordem,'metrica' tipo,item,valor,CAST(NULL AS STRING) id_1,CAST(NULL AS STRING) id_2 FROM metrics
UNION ALL SELECT 2,'exemplo_correspondente','id_car_id_imovel',id_car,id_referencia_bacen FROM matched QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY id_car)<=5
UNION ALL SELECT 3,'exemplo_sem_correspondencia','id_car_sem_imovel',id_car,id_referencia_bacen FROM unmatched WHERE id_car IS NOT NULL QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY id_car)<=5
ORDER BY ordem,item,id_1

WITH e AS (
 SELECT id_embargo,id_auto,id_municipio,ano
 FROM `basedosdados.br_ibama_fiscalizacao.area_embargada`
 WHERE ano >= 1987 AND id_auto IS NOT NULL
), a AS (
 SELECT id_auto FROM `basedosdados.br_ibama_fiscalizacao.auto_infracao`
 WHERE ano >= 1977 AND id_auto IS NOT NULL

    numero_ordem,
    id_car,
    ano_emissao
  FROM `basedosdados.br_bcb_sicor.recurso_publico_propriedade`
  WHERE ano_emissao = 2026
    AND id_car IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(id_car) != ''
), car AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(id_imovel)), '-', '') AS id_car_normalizado,
    id_imovel,
    id_municipio,
    sigla_uf,
    area AS area_imovel_ha
  FROM `basedosdados.br_sfb_sicar.area_imovel`
  WHERE data_extracao IN ('2026-06-02','2026-08-01','2026-08-02','2026-08-03','2026-08-04')
), credito_imovel AS (
  SELECT
    p.id_car,
    c.id_imovel,
    c.id_municipio,
    c.sigla_uf,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(p.id_referencia_bacen, '|', p.numero_ordem)) AS operacoes,
    SUM(o.area_financiada_ha) AS area_financiada_ha,
    SUM(o.credito_brl) AS credito_brl,
    MAX(c.area_imovel_ha) AS area_imovel_ha
  FROM propriedades p
  JOIN operacoes o
    ON p.id_referencia_bacen = o.id_referencia_bacen
   AND p.numero_ordem = o.numero_ordem
  JOIN car c
    ON p.id_car = REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(c.id_imovel)), '-', '')
  GROUP BY p.id_car,c.id_imovel,c.id_municipio,c.sigla_uf
), pam AS (
  SELECT
    id_municipio,
    SUM(quantidade_produzida) AS producao_ton,
    SUM(valor_producao) AS valor_producao_mil_brl,
    SUM(area_colhida) AS area_colhida_ha
  FROM `basedosdados.br_ibge_pam.lavoura_temporaria`
  WHERE ano = 2024
  GROUP BY id_municipio
), mapbiomas AS (
  SELECT
    id_municipio,
    SUM(area) AS area_mapeada_ha,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id_classe) AS classes_presentes
  FROM `basedosdados.br_mapbiomas_estatisticas.cobertura_municipio_classe`
  WHERE ano = 2025
  GROUP BY id_municipio
)
SELECT
  c.id_car,
  c.id_imovel,
  c.id_municipio,
  c.sigla_uf,
  c.operacoes,
  c.area_financiada_ha,
  c.credito_brl,
  c.area_imovel_ha,
  p.producao_ton,
  p.valor_producao_mil_brl,
  p.area_colhida_ha,
  m.area_mapeada_ha,
  m.classes_presentes
FROM credito_imovel c
LEFT JOIN pam p USING (id_municipio)
LEFT JOIN mapbiomas m USING (id_municipio)
ORDER BY c.credito_brl DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH car AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id_imovel
  FROM `basedosdados.br_sfb_sicar.area_imovel`
  WHERE data_extracao='2026-08-04' AND id_imovel IS NOT NULL
), s AS (
  SELECT id_car
  FROM `basedosdados.br_bcb_sicor.recurso_publico_propriedade`
  WHERE ano_emissao=2026 AND id_car IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(id_car) != ''
), tests AS (
  SELECT 'literal' transformacao, s.id_car, c.id_imovel
  FROM s LEFT JOIN car c ON s.id_car = c.id_imovel
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'trim_upper', s.id_car, c.id_imovel
  FROM s LEFT JOIN car c ON UPPER(TRIM(s.id_car)) = UPPER(TRIM(c.id_imovel))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'remove_nao_alfanumericos', s.id_car, c.id_imovel
  FROM s LEFT JOIN car c ON REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(s.id_car)), r'[^A-Z0-9]', '') = REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(c.id_imovel)), r'[^A-Z0-9]', '')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'remove_hifens', s.id_car, c.id_imovel
  FROM s LEFT JOIN car c ON REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(s.id_car)), '-', '') = REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(c.id_imovel)), '-', '')
)
SELECT
  transformacao,
  COUNT(*) AS registros_sicor,
  COUNTIF(id_imovel IS NOT NULL) AS registros_correspondentes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(id_imovel IS NOT NULL,id_car,NULL)) AS ids_correspondentes,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(id_imovel IS NOT NULL),COUNT(*)) AS cobertura_registros
FROM tests
GROUP BY transformacao
ORDER BY transformacao

WITH car_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(id_imovel)), '-', '') id_norm
  FROM `basedosdados.br_sfb_sicar.area_imovel`
  WHERE data_extracao IN ('2026-06-02','2026-08-01','2026-08-02','2026-08-03','2026-08-04') AND id_imovel IS NOT NULL
), s AS (
  SELECT REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(id_car)), '-', '') id_norm
  FROM `basedosdados.br_bcb_sicor.recurso_publico_propriedade`
  WHERE ano_emissao=2026 AND id_car IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(id_car) != ''
), unmatched AS (
  SELECT s.id_norm
  FROM s LEFT JOIN car_ids c USING(id_norm)
  WHERE c.id_norm IS NULL
)
SELECT
  LENGTH(id_norm) AS comprimento,
  SUBSTR(id_norm,1,2) AS uf_prefixo,
  SUBSTR(id_norm,3,7) AS municipio_embutido,
  COUNT(*) AS registros,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id_norm) AS ids_distintos,
  COUNTIF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(id_norm,r'^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{7}[A-F0-9]{32}$')) AS formato_estrutural_valido
FROM unmatched
GROUP BY comprimento,uf_prefixo,municipio_embutido
ORDER BY registros DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH car_municipios AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id_municipio
  FROM `basedosdados.br_sfb_sicar.area_imovel`
  WHERE data_extracao IN ('2026-06-02','2026-08-01','2026-08-02','2026-08-03','2026-08-04')
    AND id_municipio IS NOT NULL
), car_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(id_imovel)), '-', '') AS id_norm
  FROM `basedosdados.br_sfb_sicar.area_imovel`
  WHERE data_extracao IN ('2026-06-02','2026-08-01','2026-08-02','2026-08-03','2026-08-04')
    AND id_imovel IS NOT NULL
), sicor_unmatched AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(s.id_car)), '-', '') AS id_norm,
    SUBSTR(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(s.id_car)), '-', ''),3,7) AS id_municipio
  FROM `basedosdados.br_bcb_sicor.recurso_publico_propriedade` s
  LEFT JOIN car_ids c
    ON REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(s.id_car)), '-', '') = c.id_norm
  WHERE s.ano_emissao = 2026
    AND s.id_car IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(s.id_car) != ''
    AND c.id_norm IS NULL
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS ids_sicor_nao_encontrados,
  COUNTIF(cm.id_municipio IS NOT NULL) AS ids_em_municipio_com_outros_car,
  COUNTIF(cm.id_municipio IS NULL) AS ids_em_municipio_sem_car,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id_municipio) AS municipios_dos_ids_nao_encontrados,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(cm.id_municipio IS NOT NULL,id_municipio,NULL)) AS municipios_com_outros_car
FROM sicor_unmatched u
LEFT JOIN car_municipios cm USING(id_municipio)
